records.title: XRPL AI Hub — live t54 Labs x402 facilitator and service directory dashboard
records.note: The t54-operated live dashboard at capture reports all-time value settled USD42,048.63, volume settled 14,736,175, 183 registered merchants and 5,258 live services. Its directory separately reports 5,258 services, 45 merchants with live services, 131 providers and 40 named merchants plus five unnamed addresses. The live settlement list contains entries marked 'Unverified' even though the page banner says 'verified before settle'. It advertises x402 payments in XRP and IOU tokens RLUSD/USDC. Its Oct 14 update says batch settlement on XRPL Checks entered closed beta on mainnet: one Check can settle many x402 requests, reducing fee per paid request from 10 to 0.36 drops in a measured Oct 14–17 session. These are operator-reported dashboard figures, not independently audited totals; service payments, ledger transactions, merchants, providers and services are different units.

records.title: t54 Labs — XRP Ledger surpasses 10 million x402 payments through t54 facilitator
records.note: t54 says XRPL had surpassed 10M x402 payments through its facilitator by 2026-10-01 and that the seven-day average exceeded 500,000 payments/day. This is a company statement citing the XRPL AI Hub, not an independently audited ledger total. The payment count is a service/payment count and should not be equated with native XRP volume or unique users.

records.title: Mastercard — Agent Pay for Machines launch and initial partner ecosystem
records.note: Mastercard lists more than 30 initial participants/supporters, including Coinbase, Ripple and t54 Labs. AP4M is described as a multi-rail service supporting credentialing, permissioning and settlement across cards, accounts and stablecoins. The press release does not identify XRP as an AP4M settlement asset or describe an XRPL-specific production integration. Partner participation is not proof of transaction volume.

records.title: The Block — Ripple and Franklin Templeton join t54 Labs USD5M seed round
records.note: The Block reports a USD5M seed round co-led by Anagram and PL Capital with participation from Franklin Templeton, Ripple, Virtuals Ventures, Blockchain Coinvestors and ABCDE. t54's own announcement confirms Ripple's strategic participation. The Block reports founder Chandler Fang said no investors took board, advisory or observer seats and the round structure/valuation were not disclosed. The Block also reports t54 is live on XRPL, Solana and Base and built x402-secure for Coinbase-incubated x402.

records.title: t54 Labs — strategic collaboration with Evernorth for agentic treasury operations on XRPL
records.note: t54 says Evernorth intends to integrate its agentic-finance infrastructure and trust layer into autonomous treasury operations on XRPL, with verification, risk assessment and compliance. The announcement is forward-looking and describes intended integration and product collaboration; it does not establish production deployment, amount of XRP controlled by agents, or completed transactions.

records.title: The Block — Evernorth names Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo as first XRP treasury partners
records.note: The Block reports Evernorth held approximately 473M XRP, valued around USD648M at the article's price snapshot, and named Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo as first partners. Evernorth planned to begin with institutional strategies in Q4 2026 and later expand into XRP Ledger lending and credit; no amount of XRP deployed to any partner or strategy was disclosed. The article identifies Hugo Jeandesboz, former Coinbase Asset Management co-CIO and former Coinbase lead derivatives trader, as Evernorth CIO overseeing the program.

records.title: t54 Labs — MOU with Arco Financial to explore agentic finance on XRPL
records.note: t54 says it signed an MOU to explore connecting Arco Vault to XRPL, combining tokenized-asset allocation with t54's pre-transaction agent risk assessment. This is an exploration MOU, not a deployed integration, live allocation volume or XRP demand.

records.title: t54 Labs — MOU with Hecto Financial to explore AI-agent payments
records.note: t54 says it signed an MOU with Hecto Financial to explore agent identity verification and transaction risk assessment connected to existing payment and settlement infrastructure. The announcement describes exploratory discussions, not a production integration or completed XRPL settlement.
